clips.title: The story
paras: Dustwallow Bay is an inlet of the Great Sea tucked between the sodden coast of Dustwallow Marsh and the fortified port of Theramore Isle. Its brackish coastal shallows teem with marine life, treacherous shoals, and secluded coves just off the main maritime routes of eastern Kalimdor.

Dustwallow Bay defines the coastal boundary where the stagnant, murky wetlands of Dustwallow Marsh meet the open waters of the Great Sea. Flanked to the east by Theramore Isle, the bay serves as an oceanic approach for vessels arriving at Lady Jaina Proudmoore's island haven. Despite heavy maritime traffic running to and from the docks, the surrounding coastline remains wild and hazardous, pocked with rocky outcrops, murloc encampments, and tucked-away inlets like Tidefury Cove.

While the marsh itself is infested with crocolisks and hostile beasts, the bay's islands and inlets draw those who seek isolation and rich catches. The small islets dotting the waters near Tidefury Cove provide a secluded retreat for anglers, most notably the legendary fisherman Nat Pagle, who can often be found angling off the rocks away from the bustling city of Theramore.
